relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: which indicates that TRPV1 expression and channel activity in CIPN are regulated by TLR4

relationships.subject: CaMKII
relationships.evidence_quote: active CaMKII can directly phosphorylate TRPV1 channels at specific sites Ser 502 and Thr 704

relationships.subject: PKA
relationships.evidence_quote: c-AMP-dependent PKA phosphorylates the n-terminus of TRPV1

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: This activation of sensory neurons results in the release of inflammatory mediators such as calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) and substance P

relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: Many endogenous inflammatory mediators (such as prostaglandin E2 and bradykinin, as well as nerve injury factors like nerve growth factor and TNF-α, etc.) have been shown to act directly or sensitize TRPV1 through secondary messengers and/or protein modifications

relationships.subject: Capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: capsaicin, a TRPV1 agonist, alleviates pain by inducing receptor desensitization

key_findings: Review: TRPV1 acts as a pain switch via sensitization (PKA, PKC, CaMKII, TLR4) or desensitization (capsaicin) in CIPN and diabetic neuropathy
TRPV1 inhibition or siRNA reduces chemotherapy-induced mechanical hypersensitivity in preclinical models
